title: Matam Kar Matam
body:
Sab milke kare matam matam kare matam
Dil me rakhe sadaat ka gham matam kare matam
Nawha padho shabber ka aye matami zanjeer ka matam kar matam
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Dono shaane karke qalam ooncha kiya hai dee ka alam
Hum shakle khaiber geer ka aye matami zanjeer ka
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Karbobala me mara gaya shr jawa hai sugra ka
Nabi paak ki tasweer ka aye matami zanjeer ka
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Qasim ka pamaal badan loota gaya farwa ka chaman
Ujdi hui taqdeer ka aye matami zanjeer ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Maula asgar hai masoom zulm ne cheda hai hulqoom
Masoom ka besheer ka aye matami zanjeer ka
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sajde me hai qtl hua zahra ke nazoo ka pala
Noke sina pe taqreer ka aye matami zanjeer ka
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Shaame gareeba aayi thi chadare sab ke cheeni thi
Un waarise tatheer ka aye matami zanjeer ka
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Be parda bazaar gaye ahle haram darbaar gaye
Sadat ki tash-heer ka aye matami zanjeer ka
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Haaye kare baba baba koi nahi masooma ka
Sajjad ki hamsheer ka aye matami zanjeer ka
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Zaigam-o-aga karo buka ghar ghar matam karo bapa
Ye zainabe dilgeer ka aye matami zanjeer ka
